description: This file defines the class BugsQuickCreate, which extends QuickCreate to provide a quick creation form interface for bug records within the SuiteCRM application. It handles form processing, populates select options, and sets up JavaScript for client-side interactions.

classes.name: BugsQuickCreate
classes.description: A class that extends QuickCreate to implement quick creation of bug entries, including setting up form options and JavaScript interactions.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Prepares the quick create form for bugs, assigns options for priority, status, and type, and injects necessary JavaScript, handling both regular and AJAX invocations.
